correctness.rationale: Independently implemented men-proposing DA using a FIFO proposal queue rather than the package's stack/simultaneous-round code. Across every 46656 labeled strict 3x3 profile, all 3 receiver agents and their 5 alternative full-list permutations, found exactly 864 manipulable profiles, 648 with one manipulator, 216 with two, 1080 profitable woman-profile pairs each with exactly one profitable report. Independently generated all 36 independent S3xS3 relabelings for all 864 bad profiles and verified 24 orbits of size 36. The source verifier additionally tests true-stability for every profitable outcome and n<=2 boundary; universal claims are only for the exhaustive finite market, not higher n.
